text:
noah: quick heads-up — did a tiny bitsandbytes llm.int8 weight-only sweep on sylph-13b (hf:sylph-13b-open). baseline is fp16 prod profile. posting numbers and a few odd failures i noticed.

maria: nice. which bnb version?

noah: started with bnb 0.38. command:
```
python -m runner --model sylph-13b --quantize llm_int8 --bitsandbytes 0.38 \
  --batch 1 --seq 2048 --kv-cache on --dtype float16
```

noah: small regression suite (slices: reasoning, math, dialog, short-form):
- MMLU: fp16 63.2 -> int8 62.6  (-0.6)
- HellaSwag: 79.1 -> 77.9  (-1.2)
- Winogrande: 71.4 -> 71.2  (-0.2)
- Perplexity (lm eval): 9.3 -> 10.1  (+0.8)

noah: perf:
- token latency avg: fp16 3.1ms -> int8 2.0ms
- throughput t/s: fp16 120 -> int8 180
- GPU mem: fp16 35GB -> int8 24GB

aj: solid perf wins. HellaSwag and MMLU drops are concerning for some use-cases.

kevin: which slice shows biggest degradation?

noah: numeric reasoning (math slice) is worst: about -2.5 absolute on arithmetic/carry prompts. dialog/short-form look fine.

noah: observed concrete failure pattern: large-digit multiplication sometimes off by small integers in int8. example:
"Compute: 1234567 * 42 ="
fp16 -> "51851814"
int8 -> "51851810"  // off by 4

maria: sounds like final-layer quant noise. did you try keeping LayerNorm and lm_head in fp16?

noah: not yet. plan to run mixed-layers next.

eva: fyi bnb 0.39 has a LayerNorm-related fix that reduced similar edge regressions for us. also try quant_type and block_size tuning.

noah: current defaults were block_size=128, quant_type=dynamic.

maria: also test with --use_triton_offload=false; kernel differences impacted outputs in earlier runs.

ej (aj): add that failing prompt to the math regression set and use it as a canary.

kevin: log raw token probs during canary to inspect rounding/uncertainty.

noah: proposed rollout:
1) rerun with bnb 0.39 + keep LayerNorm + lm_head fp16
2) targeted eval on math/regression + full quality subset
3) canary on dedicated pool with 5% traffic; monitors: perplexity, math-slice accuracy, latency, mem
4) auto-fallback to fp16 if perplexity delta > 0.8 OR math accuracy drop > 1.5

maria: include a compact integer-edgecases prompt set (carry/borrow) and check greedy vs beam outputs.
eva: also do a tiny cpu fp32 run to rule out tokenizer edgecases.

noah: expected mem tradeoffs: fp16 35GB, int8(all) 24GB, int8+mixed-layers ~28GB.

rollout-bot: Canary template updated: target dev-dedicated pool at 5% traffic; monitors: perplexity, math-accuracy, latency, mem. will alert on thresholds.

noah: uploading artifacts and eval logs now; will post updated numbers after bnb0.39 + mixed-layers sweep tomorrow.

maria: maybe also test with different block_size (64/256) and quant_type=static to see impact.
eva: small note — keeping layers fp16 reduces mem win but often preserves quality; good trade for prod.

noah: got it. thanks all :thumbsup:

rollout-bot: Canary scheduled once new artifacts are uploaded and health checks pass.
